Abductive move: I supply the causal arrow that a bestowed abundance creates a ritual obligation of directed gratitude. Reading change: “al-kawthar” reads as entrusted superabundance whose first visible fruit is worship, not as a possession that stops with the recipient.

Structural cue: the middle grant of “kawthar” faces the final exclusive judgment “he is the abtar.” Assigned role: ك ث ر supplies the surplus side of a rivalry; ب ت ر supplies the failed rival’s lack; س م و supplies the field of public elevation/repute. Abductive move: I infer a social contest in which the hater’s attempt to define the addressee as cut short is answered by divine over-abundance. Reading change: the ayah reads as a reversal of hostile accounting: the addressee’s share is not merely “much,” but much in the exact arena where the hater imagines lack.

Reading change: “al-kawthar” becomes dynamically fertile abundance, like cloudburst, rising dust, and plant interior, rather than an abstract numeral.
